invariants.rationale: The method returns an ArrayList instance, never null, so result is always non-null.
The return type of the method and its implementation always provides a List, specifically an ArrayList.
The method expects a non-null partitionPath and uses it directly in method calls.
If result has elements, partitionPath must not be null because it is required to obtain them.
The method adds only new SmallFile objects to the result list, so all entries are non-null.
